send_email: send an email to recipients with optional subject, content, cc, and file attachments
list_emails: list emails in a folder like INBOX with pagination using offset and limit parameters
search_emails: search emails by query string across sender, recipients, subject, and content fields
reply_to_email: reply to an existing email by ID with optional content and file attachments
download_attachments: download email attachments from a specified email ID to a local directory path
